description: This file contains test cases for talking configuration contracts, including loading fixture data, testing provider selection, and timeout configurations. It defines data structures for fixture data, loads JSON fixtures, and contains test functions to verify the parsing logic in the TalkConfigParsing component.

classes.name: TalkConfigContractFixture
classes.description: Defines the structure of fixture data used for testing talk configuration selection and timeout cases.

classes.description: Provides static methods to load fixture data from JSON files.

methods.description: Searches for fixture JSON file starting from a directory hierarchy upward.
